result.paraphrase: Exos 7E8 key benefits include hyperscale and cloud datacenter use, massive scale-out data centers, OLTP and HPC workloads, high-density RAID storage, mainstream enterprise external storage arrays, distributed file systems such as Hadoop and Ceph, enterprise backup and restore for D2D and virtual tape, and centralized surveillance. Technical specifications: base model ST4000NM0025, 4TB capacity, 128MB cache, SuperParity yes, low halogen yes, PowerChoice Technology yes, 512 bytes per sector, 5-year limited warranty, 7200 RPM spindle speed, interface access speeds of 12.0, 6.0, and 3.0 Gb/s, maximum sustained transfer rate of 215 MB/s, average latency of 4.16 ms, height 1.028 in/26.1 mm max, width 4.010 in/101.85 mm, depth 5.787 in/147.0 mm, and weight 680 g/1.5 lb.
